<subject>Re: mining policy forum</subject>
<body>
Hi Jessica --

Emily is a Kalgoorlie commissioner and we have invited two other Kalgoorlie commissioners.  Assuming one of her colleagues, Morgan Blackburn or Austin Huang accept, there is not a need to send an alternate. We appreciate the offer though.

Thanks, 
Michelle Gonzales
Head of Operations
Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd
Phone: 08 9234 5678
</body>

Subject:	FW: mining policy forum

FYI...

 -----Original Message-----
From: 	"Fisher, Ellen" <ellen.fisher@pilbaraminerals.com.au>

Subject:	mining policy forum


Mr. Richmond, 
Thank you for your kind invitation to participate in the interesting program that you are sponsoring in October.  Unfortunately, I have a conflicting commitment and will be unable to attend.  May I pass the information on to one of the other Commissioners here, or have you also invited others from our commission?
Thank you. 
Ellen Fisher
